scenario-agi.case_for_change: GPT-6.2 Astra scored 99.8% on ARC-AGI-3 with OpenAI’s adapter.
scenario-agi.challenge: With the standard setup, the same model scored 70.3%. The result depends on how the test runs.
scenario-agi.judgement: One set of interactive tasks gives us too little evidence about performance across all ten domains.
scenario-agi.reconsider: Two independent teams test the same frozen system on fresh tasks and reproduce skilled-human performance across the ten domains.

scenario-agentic-work.case_for_change: OpenAI tracked over 1,700 performance investigations in just over three months. Its workflow found root causes in more than 600.
scenario-agentic-work.challenge: Engineers decide what ships. How many cases finished without anyone stepping in? The report leaves that open.
scenario-agentic-work.judgement: One workflow shows that agents can investigate real problems. We need evidence that teams can repeat this across organisations.
scenario-agentic-work.reconsider: Customers publish 90 days of case logs across multiple systems. The logs count manual rescues, failures and completed cases.

scenario-robotics.case_for_change: GXO completed a warehouse picking pilot. Apptronik evaluated more than 50 tasks in its training facility.
scenario-robotics.challenge: The wider warehouse trials are planned for 2027. We still lack six months of operating costs and intervention records across ten sites.
scenario-robotics.judgement: The pilot makes wider use plausible. Field results will show whether robots can switch jobs economically.
scenario-robotics.reconsider: Customers publish six months of results for several jobs, including human interventions and the full cost per successful task.

scenario-software-automation.case_for_change: OpenAI’s agents investigate a slowdown, propose code changes and check performance after deployment.
scenario-software-automation.challenge: People decide which fixes ship. The report counts investigations and leaves open how often eligible tickets needed manual corrections or rollbacks.
scenario-software-automation.judgement: We have evidence for several steps of delivery at one organisation. Reliable completion across ten organisations remains an open question.
scenario-software-automation.reconsider: Teams publish consecutive eligible tickets, including failed deployments, rollbacks and the work people did to rescue a change.

scenario-education-disruption.case_for_change: In a randomised sixth-form study, students using the AI tutor reported more effort and difficulty during part of a maths session.
scenario-education-disruption.challenge: The session lasted 90 minutes. The study did not test what students could do unaided eight weeks later.
scenario-education-disruption.judgement: Effort during a lesson tells us little about how much learning lasts after the tutor goes away.
scenario-education-disruption.reconsider: Two independent trials find learning gains on delayed, unaided tests after at least a term of tutoring.
